sources: Predicting through Jaimini Astrology - V.P. Goel (rules6)
goel_basics: Dasha of Jaimini are not based on moon.
Calculation of strength of planets and houses are elaborate in Parashar and need detail calculations. This calculation is simple in Jaimini.
goel_argala_rules: planets in 4th, 2nd, and 11th cause Argala. These are countered or obstructed by planets in 10th, 12th and 3rd
Planets in 5th also cause Argala. This is countered by planets in 9th
three or more malefic in 3rd house, they cause Vipreet Argala and is very favorable
planets causing Argala is stronger than those obstructing then the former will prevail
There is no counter for the Argala caused by three planets in third house
When there is an Argala on lagna, Arudha lagna and from seventh from them, the person will be famous and fortunate
unobstructed Argala and aspecting lagna will make a person
goel_raja_yoga_pairs: AK + AmK conjunction or mutual sign aspect: raja yoga material.
AK + PK, AK + DK, AK + 5th lord: soul-level status yogas.
AmK + PK, AmK + DK, AmK + 5th lord: career-wealth yogas.
PK + DK, PK + 5th lord, DK + 5th lord: progeny-partnership yogas.
Benefics in 2nd, 4th, 5th from AmK: high status.
AmK in 3 or 6 with malefics or their aspect: professional skill/success.
AmK in kendra/trikona/11 from AK: easier success; trika from AK: success after struggle.
Same raja yogas repeating in D9: fruits come easier.

superior: Involvement of the natural benefics especially those with good dignity or other sources of strength. This would include exalted planets, even if natural malefics.
Involvement of at least three planets in one of the argala positions.
Involvement of the planets in all three argala positions.
above_average: Involvement of both natural benefics and malefics in the argala positions.
Involvement of at least two planets in one of the argala positions.
Involvement of the planets in two of the argala positions.
average: Involvement of only malefics in the argala position.
Involvement of only one planet in the argala position.

Only one planet in an argala. The idea here, as I understand it, is that the better the argala qualifying and supporting a yogada planet, the better and more reliable will be the effects of such a graha in conferring good fortune. This, of course, is provided that the argala is effectively obstructed. To summarize then:

In the Jaimini system certain planets become yogadas, or givers of good fortune by simultaneously being conjunct or having rasi drsti with the special lagnas, bhava, hora and ghatikd, as well as the 1st and 7th house. JEWELS OF JAIMINI
These yogada conditions of a planet can apply in the rasi, navamsa, and drekkana.
If such planets are in good conditions and have sources of strength such as exaltation, own sign etc. they become even more empowered to be "yoga

For the full fructification of the yogada it is necessary that there be unobstructed argala formation to it. The more superior this is the better. Since a fully yogada planet is said in siitra 1.3.25 to make a person a rdjanah or "king," I will begin illustrating this concept with the birth charts of those who were actually kings or queens, as well as those of their modern

day equivalents, which is to say, heads of states. jewels_yogada_rules: The more a planet does this, the better, and the more it becomes a yogada, a planet capable of bestowing good fortune on a person. If such a planet has sources of strength such as own/exaltation sign, then it can do so in great measure.
The identification of such planets should be done in the birth chart, navamsa and drekkana.

goel_raja_yoga_extra: Conjunction or mutual sign aspect of Venus and Moon gives excellence.
Same planet aspecting bhava, hora and ghatika lagna gives status and wealth.
One planet aspecting the same house in D1, D3 and D9 gives prosperity.
Mars, Venus, Ketu in 3/11 pattern with mutual aspect (Vaithanika yoga).
Benefics in 2nd, 4th, 5th from AmK give high status.
AmK in 3rd or 6th with Mars, Sun, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu (or their aspect) gives professional success.
Equal number of planets in lagna and 4th gives happiness.
Repeat yogas in navamsha - fruits come with less effort.
